why: The shared SSRF-validated sink safe_get() was deleted, along with the two tests that proved a blocked URL never reached httpx (the booby-trapped httpx.get). The rule SVC-006 was satisfied by removing the only place the guard and the fetch were one auditable expression; every call site now re-implements it inline, where it can be omitted. Catalogue 1 and 2 — the deleted tests are the ones that could actually fail.
